sql.if: AND ri.created_at < (CAST(#{to} AS date) + INTERVAL '1 day')

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control) AS treated, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted) AS conversions, COALESCE(SUM(io.revenue_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted), 0) AS revenue, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.retained) AS defended FROM retention_intervention ri LEFT JOIN intervention_outcome io ON io.intervention_id = ri.intervention_id

SELECT ri.action_type AS actionType, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control), 0), 1) AS treatPct, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ri.is_control AND io.converted) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ri.is_control), 0), 1) AS controlPct, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted) AS conv, COALESCE(SUM(io.revenue_amount) FILTER (WHERE NOT ri.is_control AND io.converted), 0) AS revenue FROM retention_intervention ri LEFT JOIN intervention_outcome io ON io.intervention_id = ri.intervention_id
GROUP BY ri.action_type ORDER BY revenue DESC
